response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial exposure (GISCollective, Green Map, FOSS4G talk) and demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput backend work at Sociomantic using D with async I/O and fibers, which maps conceptually to the performance demands of a routing pipeline. However, the core requirement — modern C++ (or Rust) in commercial/open-source settings — is barely met: his only C/C++ role was a six-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015, and his recent decade is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js product work. He also lacks navigation guidance or routing-tile pipeline experience and shows no distributed-systems depth around consistency, fault tolerance, or service discovery. He fits the 'willing to work beyond current expertise' criterion well, but would require significant ramp-up on the primary technology stack.
strengths: Real geospatial/GIS product experience, including a self-founded open-source mapping platform
Proven low-latency, high-volume systems work (millions of req/s) with async I/O and caching
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, and broad full-stack adaptability
concerns: Modern C++/Rust experience is minimal and over a decade old; recent work is TypeScript/Node
No navigation, routing, or map-tiling pipeline background
Limited evidence of distributed-systems fundamentals (consistency, fault tolerance, service discovery)
